in_marathi.name: Deepalakshmi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wealth and prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deepalakshmi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deepa means 'lamp' or 'light' and Lakshmi is the Hindu goddess of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. The name Deepalakshmi signifies the goddess who bestows wealth and illuminates the path towards prosperity.
